policies.B1: Qualification for high-tier quality status is granted if an item attains an international safety score of at least 90 points, maintains a recycled material proportion of 40 % or higher, possesses ISO 9001 certification, or carries a warranty duration of 4 years or more.
policies.B2: Clearance for commercial vehicle fleet distribution requires high-tier quality status.
policies.D1: Listing within corporate supply databases requires clearance for business fleet distribution alongside an operating history of 2 years or more.
policies.B3: Compliance with heavy-duty energy requirements is granted when a unit provides a peak output of at least 400 watts.
policies.B4: Authorization for city transport usage is granted if a vehicle retains UL 2272 safety clearance.

decoy_policies: An item earns priority warehouse placement if its total shipping weight is under 15 kilograms and its packaging volume is below 2 cubic meters.
Preferred vendor recognition requires an active environmental audit rating above 80 points.
